note: Draft vectors for LIP-0024. No vector reads a node: what the node supplies for an outpoint is stated in the context. Signatures are BIP-340 signatures under published test keys, which belong to nobody. The grant is given as stated facts, because a grant has no members yet; its identifier, the transaction ids and the name are placeholders. A vector whose outcome is not the passing one holds one defect and names a neighbour with the passing outcome; a vector marked compound holds two defects and names none. No verdict of this file records a closure.

fields.scripts: seal_public_key is a compressed key and script_hex a script; expect says whether the script is the seal script of E1.2 for that key.
fields.endorsements: endorsement holds the octets of the signed form, as hex and, where they are text, as text. context.pinned_grant_public_key is the grant key of the pinned issuer, an x-only key; context.construction_profile is the value of the verifier's configuration; context.node_output is what the verifier's node supplies for the endorsed outpoint, or null; context.grant states the identifier of the grant, its chain, its issuer pin and its seal outpoint.
